text:
[
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-1",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "The System needs to designed to prevent full scan of Patient Consultation Request Entity for identifying the Appointments for next day/ day range.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-2",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "For this, a derived Entity called as Patient Appointment file shall be designed.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-3",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "To prevent multiple doctors of the same speciality to log-in onto same Patient Consultation Request, a workflow system needs to be designed which routes the Patient Consultation Requests to Doctors.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-4",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "Similarly once the doctor has completed the prescription, the workflow should be routed to the right Chemist (based on Patient and Chemist Pincode) and /or Labs (based on Patient and Lab PinCode).",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-5",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "In order to Assist Doctors, a Machine learning algorithm will be designed and trained on a training data-set to predict diseases based on Patient Symptoms.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-6",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "this algorithm will continue to be trained on emerging data sets to improve the quality of predictions.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-7",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "The database shall be maintained by the Administration.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-8",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "Patients who have not consulted for last 3 years would get archived onto a parallel database.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-9",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "Restoring of old Patients data is beyond the scope of the project and would need to be managed by Admin.",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-10",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "System needs to be designed to cater to approximately 25,000 Consultation Requests per week, translating to 1.3 Million Consultation Requests per year.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-11",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "System needs to be designed to cater to a 3 year database which would constitute 4.0 Million Consultation requests.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-12",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "System needs to be designed to cater to approximately 250,000 unique Patients expected to be provisioned.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-13",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "The system has to be designed keeping the future growth in mind, expecting the number of specialities to grow to 5 by end of year 3, which may mean further addition of 50,000 unique patients and another 500,000 Consultation Requests.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-14",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "The system should be capable of running on a mobile platform in future (android).",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-15",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "This will mean designing of user interfaces keeping adaptive response in mind.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-16",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "Care needs to be taken from a usability perspective in terms of font sizes and ease of system usage for Elderly and infirm people.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-17",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "The system should be designed to keep the system navigation very simple and intuitive so that people with no computer background should be able to use the system relatively easily.",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.5-18",
    "section": "2.5",
    "section_title": "Design and Implementation Constraints",
    "text": "A normal Consultation Request should get filled in less than 5 minutes (Minimal and only relevant questions).",
    "kind": "nonfunctional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.6-1",
    "section": "2.6",
    "section_title": "User Documentation",
    "text": "An Installation Guide shall be prepared.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-2.6-2",
    "section": "2.6",
    "section_title": "User Documentation",
    "text": "A User Manual for end users shall be prepared.",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  }
]
